spans.s: मातु the same as मतुप् a tad. affix showing possession; the word is frequently used in Pāṇini's rules for मतुप्. cf. मतोश्च बह्वजङ्गात् | P. IV 2.72; cf. also,
; for the sense of मतु see मतुप् below. The affix मतु (instead of मतुप् of Pāṇini) is found in the Atharva Prātiśakhya.
मतुप् tad. affix मत् changed in some cases to वत् (cf मादुपधायाश्च मतोर्वोऽयवादिभ्यः

), applied to any noun or substantive in the sense of 'who possesses that,' or 'which contains it,' or in the sense of possession as popularly expressed. The affix is called possessive affix also, and is very commonly found in use; e. g. गोमान्, वृक्षवान् , यवमान् , etc. cf. तदस्यास्त्यस्मिन्निति मतुप्

. The very general sense of 'possession' is limited to certain kinds of possession by the Vārttikakāra in the following stanza; भूमनिन्दाप्रशंसासु नित्ययोगेतिशायने | संसर्गेऽस्तिविवक्षायां भवन्ति मतुबादय: cf. Kāś. on
. There are other tad. affixes prescribed in the same sense as मतुप्, such as the affixes लच् (

-98), इलच् (99, 100, 105, 117), श and न (100), ण (101), विनि (102, 121, 122), इनि (102, 115, 116, 128, 129-137), अण् (103, 104), उरच् (106), र (107), म (108), व ( 109, 110), ईरन् and ईरच् (111), वलच् (112, 113), ठन् (115, 116), ठञ् (118, 119), यप् (120), युस् (123, 138, 140), ग्मिनि (124), आलच् and आटच् (125), अच् (127), and ब, भ, यु, ति, तु, त and यस् each one applied to spe- cifically stated words. मतुप् is also specially prescribed after the words headed by रस (cf. रसादिभ्यश्च

) in supersession of some of the other affixes mentioned above which would take place in such cases, if मतुप् were not prescribed by the rule रसादिभ्यश्च. The portion of the Aṣṭādhyāyī prescribing the possessive affixes is named मतुबधिकार (
मतुप्पाद a conventional name given by grammarians to the third pāda of the eighth Adhyāya of Pāṇini's Aṣṭādhyāyī as the pāda begins with the sūtra मतुवसोरु संबुद्धौ छन्दसि

मतुबर्थिक affix in the sense of मतुप् i. e. in the sense of possession. For these affixes of which इनि (इन्) is very common see the word मतुप्, cf. शैषिकान्मतुबर्थीयाच्छैषिको मतुबर्थिक: | सरूप: प्रत्ययो नेप्ट: सन्नन्तान्न सनिष्यते | M. Bh. on
मतुबर्थीय affix in the sense of मतुप् ; see मतुबर्थिक.

मतुब्लोप elision of the affix मतुप् specially prescribed after words of quality, or words meaning quality, such as शुक्ल, कृष्ण which originally mean the white colour, the black colour etc. e. g. शुक्लः पट: cf. गुणवचनेभ्यो मतुपो लुक्
मतोन्मज्जा name of a commentary on Koṇḍabhaṭṭa's Vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇa written by a grammarian named वनमालिन्.
मत्वर्थ sense in which the affix मतु ( मतुप् ) is affixed; the sense of 'possession' in general; see the word मतुप् above.
मत्वर्थीय an affix which has got the sense of मतु ( मतुप् ). See the words मतुबर्थिक and मतुबर्थीय above.
मातृकावर्ण letters of the alphabet. See अक्षरसमाम्नाय.
मात्रच् a tad. affix in the sense of measure applied optionally with द्वयस and दघ्न to a noun e.g. ऊरुमात्रम् प्रस्थमात्रम् ; cf. प्रमाणे द्वयसज्दघ्नञ्मात्रचः
and Kaasika thereon which remarks thai द्वयस and दन are applied in the sense of height, while मात्र is applied in the sense of any measure: cf. प्रथमश्च द्वितीयश्च ऊर्ध्र्वमाने मतौ मम Kaas. on
मात्रा (1) measure, quantity ; cf भवति हिं तंत्र या च यावती च अर्थमात्रा M. Bh. on
; (2) mora, prosodial unit of one instant i.e. the length of time required to pronounce a short vowel: cf. भूयसीं मात्रा इवर्णावर्णयेः, अल्पीयसी अवर्णस्य, M.Bh. on
: cf. मात्रा ह्रस्वतावदवग्रहान्तरं, द्व दीर्धः,तिस्रः प्लुत उच्यते स्वरः R. Pr.
also cf अर्धमात्रालाघवेन पुत्रोत्सवं मन्यन्ते वैयाकरणाः Par. Sek.
. The instant is taken to be equal to the throbbing of the eye, or a flash of lightning, or a note of a wood-cock.
